[red bold]-- MUTABILITY ERROR -- assign_to_let.volt:5[/red bold]

Cannot assign to `x` — it was declared with `let` (immutable).

 [dim]4 |[/dim]     let x: int = 5
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     x = 10
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]    ^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Use `var` instead of `let` to make it mutable.[/cyan]
